focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between space bar and adjacent keys
Consistency of key height and alignment across the row
Realism of plastic texture and specular highlights
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxy' texture of the keys. Real keyboards usually have some surface grain or dust. Check if the space bar's gap spacing is uniform on both sides, as AI often fails at symmetric gaps. Verify if the legend-less nature of the space bar is consistent with the surrounding keys (e.g., do other keys have legends that look gibberish?).
